问题 01 · format

operations.ts truncated mid-method by a chunked here-doc append

本任务已处理

server/providers/service/operations.ts: SyntaxError: '}' expected. (2418:1); the file ended at `async createManual(actor: ServiceActor, input: Row): Promise` with no body or closing brace, and `format:auto` exited 2 in 0.90s.

原因（实现者自述）
The implementation agent wrote the large service file through repeated `cat >> ... <<'CHUNK'` appends. One chunk was cut off (the shell logged `warning: here-document delimited by end-of-file (wanted 'CHUNK')`) and the agent's own response then hit the model output-token cap mid-thought (`stopReason: length`, thinking "Oops, my heredoc"), so the truncation was never noticed or repaired.
处理方式
Read the migration and seed as the schema source of truth, removed the truncated fragment, and re-wrote the missing tail: attachment read/register/detach/resolve, manual CRUD and indexing, external-platform intake with eventId idempotency, integration status, and the dashboard/engineer-load queries. Cross-checked every `row.*`, `values.*`, `input.*` and `filter.*('col')` reference in the file against the migration's columns and fixed the remaining drifts.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · format

Service code and migration disagreed on columns and column types

本任务已处理

Latent in the same file: work orders read and wrote `acceptNoteStatus` and `acceptanceRunId` and shares read and wrote `grantedAt`, none of which existed in the migration; and `resolutionSubmittedById`/`closedById` were declared `integer` while the service and seed write the string account id.

原因（实现者自述）
The truncated file was an incomplete draft, so its later methods and the migration were written at different times and were never reconciled against each other.
处理方式
Added `acceptNoteStatus` (string, default `pending`), `acceptanceRunId` and `grantedAt` to the service schema migration, and changed `resolutionSubmittedById` / `closedById` to `string(64)` to match the account-id convention used by `createdById`. The migration was untracked and unmerged and had not been applied to any persistent database, so it was corrected in place; `db apply` was then run against a fresh SQLite database to confirm the schema, the six seeded work orders and the full demo data set apply cleanly.

问题 03 · 实现阶段

The service feature is not registered, so no business page or endpoint is reachable

本任务已处理

server/providers/index.ts and server/routes/index.ts export empty arrays, client/routes.ts declares only the home and auth pages, and there are no jobs or permission seeds. Only the migration, the seed and the six `server/providers/service/*` internals exist, so a running application shows only the homepage and the demo data is unreachable.

原因（实现者自述）
The registration, route, page, job, permission and AI/Scheduler wiring were never written: the implementation agent ran out of output tokens and then its context-overflow recovery failed (`compaction_start/overflow` -> `Context overflow recovery failed`), ending the run before the remaining files were produced.
处理方式
Registered the service provider (`app/service`) with permission-set creation, demo-account provisioning, acceptance-workflow materialization and Scheduler target/schedule registration; added the `/api/service/*` route module and the guarded file-repository exposure; declared the eleven client pages and their navigation group in client/routes.ts with zh/en keys; added the source-managed `work-order-acceptance` Workflow whose run modules write the acceptance note. Verified at runtime: sign-in, every list endpoint, the accept -> workflow -> note -> in-app inbox flow, attachment round-trip, and 401/403 gating.

问题 04 · runtime

Stale database schema: creating a work order returned 409 `Field "acceptNoteStatus" does not exist`

本任务已处理

POST /api/service/work-orders answered 409 CONFLICT `Could not allocate a work-order number: Field "acceptNoteStatus" does not exist.` against the persistent development SQLite database, while every read endpoint worked.

原因（实现者自述）
The applied database had been migrated from an earlier revision of `202611010001_service_schema` that predated `acceptNoteStatus` and `acceptanceRunId`; the file was edited afterwards, so its recorded checksum no longer matched its source and the already-recorded migration was not replayed. `db redo` could not repair it because the whole database is one batch containing an irreversible plugin migration.
处理方式
Added the conditional corrective migration `202611010003_service_acceptance_columns`, whose `shouldRun` reads the physical table through the connection's schema inspector and only alters a database that is actually missing the columns, so it is a no-op on a fresh database. `pnpm nocobase db apply` executed it as batch 2 and the columns now exist; creating a work order returns 200. The decision is pinned by tests/logic/service-acceptance-migration.test.ts and the DDL was exercised against the real database by `db apply`.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · runtime

Optional enum filter compared against `undefined`, so the route's `?? ''` default became an empty enum value

本任务已处理

GET /api/service/work-orders answered an error because the domain pushed a `priority` filter built from the empty string the route passes when the query parameter is absent; the other list endpoints were unaffected because their optional strings defaulted differently.

原因（实现者自述）
The domain treated the presence of the `priority` key as intent to filter and did not normalise or validate the value, while the route always supplies the key with a `?? ''` fallback. A unit test over pure helpers could not see this because it only fails when a repository compiles the filter.
处理方式
`listWorkOrders` now normalises the value with the shared `str` helper and only pushes an enum filter when it is non-empty, validating against `WORK_ORDER_PRIORITIES` and returning a 400 for an unknown value. Regression cases in tests/logic/service-operations-queries.test.ts assert that the empty default pushes no filter and that an unknown priority is rejected.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · runtime

Inspection generator bounded a `date` column with a datetime string

本任务已处理

POST /api/service/inspections/generate answered an error / logged `Invalid date value for Field "nextInspectionDate"` instead of creating due inspection tasks.

原因（实现者自述）
`generateDailyInspections` filtered `nextInspectionDate` with a `before('<planDate>T23:59:59+08:00')` bound, but the collection declares that field as `date`, and the repository's temporal validator refuses a datetime string for a date column. A `before` bound would also skip a device due exactly on the plan date.
处理方式
The bound is now the date-only plan value with an inclusive `notAfter`, so a device due exactly today is included and the validator accepts the comparison. The local filter-operator interface was extended with the `notBefore`/`notAfter` operators the real builder already provides. A regression case asserts the emitted filter uses a date-only value.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · runtime

Upload capability and domain rule disagreed about who may attach evidence

本任务已处理

A supervisor saw the attachment upload control because `capabilities().canUploadAttachment` is enabled for a manager, but POST /api/service/work-orders/:id/attachments answered 404 `Work order #7 was not found` for that same supervisor, because the domain allowed only the assigned engineer.

原因（实现者自述）
The two rules were written from one helper (`handler = isManager || isAssignee`) but the domain method applied a stricter `isAssignee` check, so the page offered an action the domain refused. The uploader is recorded in `uploaderId`, so allowing a supervisor does not attribute their upload to the engineer.
处理方式
`registerAttachment` now permits the assigned engineer or a supervisor, matching the capability flag (a temporary collaborator still may not). The method comment states the rule. Regression cases cover the supervisor, the unrelated engineer and the extension check.

问题 08 · build

The provider called Scheduler read methods the public token type does not declare, so pnpm build failed and the browser QA saw the blank template

本任务已处理

pnpm build failed at the Build server step with TS2339: Property 'list' / 'listOccurrences' does not exist on type 'SchedulerService' (plus implicit-any and Set<unknown> follow-on errors) in server/providers/service/provider.ts. Because the production dist was not rebuilt, the browser acceptance (NODE_ENV=production pnpm start) served a stale client, so the B01-B12 defects all reported a blank Default Template homepage with only a Home menu entry and no business pages.

原因（实现者自述）
The provider imported schedulerServiceToken from the public @nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/server/tokens entry, whose declared type only carries the registration surface (registerTarget/defineSchedule). The service actually bound to that token is the plugin's own concrete implementation, which also exposes list and listOccurrences — the same methods its management routes call — but the public declaration hides them, so the calls did not typecheck.
处理方式
Described the Scheduler read surface locally (SchedulerReadService with list/listOccurrences and minimal record shapes) and cast the resolved token to it, so the reads resolve at runtime without a deep import of the plugin's unexported internal path. Confirmed with pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit (clean), a full pnpm build (Build complete), and a production pnpm start driven by headless Chrome: the sidebar shows After-sales service with Service dashboard, Work orders, Equipment, Customers, Inspections, Repair knowledge, Equipment manuals, AI service assistant and Device integration, and GET /api/service/schedules, /dashboard, /work-orders, /customers, /equipment, /knowledge all return 200 with seeded data.

问题 09 · build

A Workflow run module imported application tokens by relative path, so the packed artifact was not relocatable

本任务已处理

At boot in the production build the Workflow loader threw `Cannot find module '.../storage/workflows/providers/service/tokens.js'` (node key `acceptNormal`); the run modules had been copied into the artifact store but their relative imports still pointed at the application source tree.

原因（实现者自述）
The `server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/server/` run modules imported app-local code (`provider.js`, `tokens.js`) by relative path. The artifact store materializes the workflow package as a copy under `storage/workflows/<key>/<digest>`, so relative imports out of the copied package root do not resolve, and only bare-package (framework) tokens are relocatable. Materializing the app tree too would have made the artifact depend on this application's build layout.
处理方式
Removed the run modules and reduced the workflow to core-only built-in nodes (a `Condition` and a `Terminate`) that contain no application imports, then moved the acceptance-note effect into the application: `ServiceOperations.runAcceptance` computes the note with a pure `acceptanceNote()` helper, calls `completeAcceptance` synchronously, and only then optionally triggers the workflow for its side effects. The effect therefore cannot be lost to a Workflow outage. The materialized artifact digest is `f8da6acfbb2b57b15a5a9c7978cdac2ccf05c13f55ed6cecbfe26789168e9d12` and the boot log reports `acceptance workflow is materialized and enabled`.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 10 · runtime

Enabling a Workflow by its current flag mismatched the materialized artifact, duplicating runs

本任务已处理

The acceptance Workflow could be enabled against the source form while a different digest was materialized, so triggers either failed to find the artifact or ran alongside a stale one.

原因（实现者自述）
`WorkflowService` records versions by content digest and materializes by digest; enabling via the `current` row selected a row whose digest was not the one on disk, and the development source and production build materialize different digests.
处理方式
`server/providers/service/provider.ts` now enables the workflow by the exact materialized `artifact.digest` and, inside one transaction, clears the sibling `current`/`enabled` flags so exactly one version is active. The digest published in the startup log is the one that must match.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

问题 13 · runtime

The AI assistant page returned 403 for every service role that could open it

本任务已处理

`/service/assistant` rendered but the AI-employee client's `aiEmployees:list` (and `llmServices:*`, `ai:listProviderModels`) returned 403 for the manager and engineer, so the readiness surface had no data to show.

原因（实现者自述）
The AI-employee plugin gates all of its settings actions behind one page grant, `{type:'page', id:'ai.settings'}`, via `requireAISettingsAccess()` in `settings-access.js`. The service permission sets granted scheduler and business pages but never `ai.settings`, and only root bypasses the check.
处理方式
Granted `pageGrant('ai.settings')` to the manager permission set (the supervisor maintains the knowledge base and needs processing status) while deliberately leaving it off the engineer set, because the same page id also carries manual upload and deletion. `client/pages/service/assistant.tsx` now checks `useCan({resource:{type:'page',id:'ai.settings'},action:'access'})` and, for a caller without it, shows a supervisor-only card instead of firing the denied requests. Verified: manager `aiEmployees:list` 200 with the readiness card, engineer 403-free with the supervisor card.

问题 14 · runtime

Knowledge-base settings page failed with 404 because the legacy portal SDK resolved an API base without the mount path

本任务已处理

`/settings/ai/knowledge-base` rendered `Unable to load this view / NocoBase request failed (404)`; the browser issued `GET /api/ai/aiKnowledgeBase:list` instead of `/main/api/ai/aiKnowledgeBase:list`.

原因（实现者自述）
The knowledge-base client builds its service through the deprecated `@nocobase/app-portal-sdk`, whose `NocoBaseClient` resolves its API base at module load from `window.NOCOBASE_API_URL` and falls back to `http://127.0.0.1:13000/api`. The v3 runtime deliberately publishes nothing on `window`; the base path lives only in the served `nocobase-runtime-config` JSON (`config.api.baseURL = /main/api`).
处理方式
Added `client/portal-api-url.ts` (`publishLegacyApiUrl()`), which reads the `nocobase-runtime-config` block and sets `window.NOCOBASE_API_URL`, and imported it first in `client/index.tsx` so the global exists before the knowledge-base plugin module is evaluated. Verified: the page now loads with no 404 or console error.

问题 18 · runtime

Work-order resolution dialog kept its stale label and re-posted after a success

本任务已处理

After submitting a resolution in the same page session, 'Reject result' opened a dialog titled 'Submit resolution' and its Confirm posted to /api/service/work-orders/6/resolution, which answered 409; the close and reject dialogs also stayed open after a successful action.

原因（实现者自述）
The detail page held one `dialog` state string and `act()` awaited the request but never cleared it, so the previous dialog's label and body were still bound to the open dialog and its submit handler targeted the resolution endpoint a second time. The 409 was the server correctly refusing the duplicate state transition.
处理方式
`act()` in client/pages/service/work-order-detail.tsx now closes the dialog (`setDialog(null)`) after a successful action, leaving it open on failure so typed input is not lost, and then reloads the record. The open dialog therefore always matches the action the user chose and a finished transition cannot be re-submitted.

问题 19 · runtime

DOCX preview could hang on 'Loading preview' and a corrupt image was accepted without feedback

本任务已处理

Opening a .docx attachment left the preview at 'Loading preview…' with no iframe and no error although the content request returned 200; uploading a corrupt PNG with naturalWidth 0 was accepted and produced no failure feedback.

原因（实现者自述）
The Office Open XML viewer awaited the renderer and the document fetch with no time bound, so a renderer that never settled left the loading state forever with no path to an error. The image branch rendered a plain <img> and ignored decode failure.
处理方式
office-open-xml-preview.tsx now bounds both the document request (15s) and the renderer load (20s) with `withTimeout`, routing a timeout through the existing error surface, and uses a ref for `t` so the effect does not re-run on an unstable callback. file-preview-content.tsx gains an `ImagePreview` that shows a loading state, flips to a localized download fallback on `onError` or `naturalWidth === 0`, and the work-order attachment upload now rejects a zero-byte file, a photo that does not decode and a report without the ZIP `PK` signature before sending it, reporting the reason as a toast.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 20 · runtime

No in-app message center, unread badge, or notifications for resolution and rejection

本任务已处理

The application had no way to open the durable in-app inbox, no unread badge in the shell, and the acceptance, resolution-submitted and rejected messages an assignee or supervisor needs could not be reached from the UI; the only inbox route was the plugin's development-only /dev page.

原因（实现者自述）
The notification-in-app plugin was registered but the application never mounted its provider, declared an authenticated inbox page or put a bell in the header, and the domain only sent a notification in `completeAcceptance`: `submitResolution` and `rejectWorkOrder` changed state without telling anyone it matters to.
处理方式
The authenticated shell in client/routing/app-router.tsx now mounts `NotificationInAppProvider`; a new header component reads `NotificationInAppRuntimeContext` for the unread count and links to a new authenticated, authorized `/service/messages` route that renders `NotificationInAppInbox`; the route is declared in client/routes.ts with `authz` and navigation, the page grant and page id are added to the four service permission sets, and `submitResolution` (to managers) and `rejectWorkOrder` (to the assignee) now send a durable notification through the same `notify`/`notifyManagers` path with a version-scoped idempotency key.

问题 21 · runtime

Overdue reminder plan scanned only inspections, still ran while disabled, and the date pickers closed their dialog

本任务已处理

The overdue-reminder plan reported `reminded: 0` while overdue work orders existed; a disabled plan could still be executed through the controlled 'Run now' action; and choosing the next-inspection date or a work-order deadline with the native date input dismissed the whole dialog.

原因（实现者自述）
`sendOverdueReminders` only looked at inspection tasks and counted each attempt rather than each accepted delivery, so overdue work orders were never reminded; `schedulerRunner.run` triggered the registered target without consulting `plan.enabled`; and the two dialogs used a native <input type='date'> inside a form the dialog treated as dismissible on change.
处理方式
`sendOverdueReminders` scans un-closed work orders whose deadline has passed (idempotency `work-order.overdue:<id>:<day>`) in addition to the inspection half, and `notify`/`notifyAssignee` now return whether the notification service accepted the message so `reminded` counts real sends and a deduplicated delivery is not recounted. `schedulerRunner.run` refuses a switched-off plan with `status: 'skipped'`, `enabled: false` and no trigger. Both dialogs now use the application `DatePicker` (popover-based, whose button defaults to type='button') with a hidden input carrying `yyyy-MM-dd` to the FormData.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 22 · runtime

List search boxes did not filter until an unhandled native submit

本任务已处理

Typing ZZZNOMATCH in the equipment or work-order list search box and pressing Enter left every row visible; the input did not filter as the user typed and had no way to clear it.

原因（实现者自述）
The search input was uncontrolled and only the surrounding form's submit navigation committed it, so an Enter that did not submit the form (or a blur) never reached the query, and there was no feedback that a filter was pending.
处理方式
Both list pages now use a controlled search input with a 300ms debounce, and commit on Enter (explicitly, rather than relying on form submission) and on blur; a ghost clear button resets the query and the page. Every commit resets to page 1 and updates the URL/query so the filter is durable and shareable.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 23 · runtime

Administrator API keys lacked the integrator role and the platform had no self-status read

本任务已处理

A key created on the administrator's own API Keys settings page authenticates as that administrator, who holds no `service-integrator` role, so an external submit answered 403; there was no way to issue a key for the integration account; and `GET /api/service/external/repairs/:id` returned the SPA fallback because no route existed.

原因（实现者自述）
The integration page told reviewers to create the key in Settings, where the plugin issues it for the signed-in administrator rather than the integration seat, and the domain exposed only the external submit and the integration status read. `ApiKeyService.remove` also deletes by id and config without checking ownership.
处理方式
The domain now resolves the integrator seat and issues and revokes keys for that account through the API Keys plugin's own `ApiKeyService` (list is a read-only projection of the plugin table filtered by the account's `referenceId` and config), never for the caller, and refuses to delete a key that does not belong to the account. Manager-only `/service/integration/account` and `/service/integration/keys` endpoints back a new account-and-keys card on the integration page (create shows the secret once, revoke confirms first). A new `GET /service/external/repairs/:id` requires the integrator role, applies the same record scope the external submit writes under, and answers an unowned or manual repair exactly as a missing one.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 工具与构建

Large files written through here-document appends can be silently truncated

可自动化

A single missing closing delimiter leaves a syntactically invalid file, and the agent only discovers it at verification time; the warning the shell prints on stderr is easy to miss among other output.

建议改动

When writing files over roughly a few hundred lines, prefer the write/edit tool or write to a temporary complete file and move it into place, and treat a here-doc EOF warning as a hard failure to re-check the file before continuing.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 验收机制

The style gate reports a syntax error before the compiler does

可自动化

`format:auto` runs first, so a malformed TypeScript file fails as a Prettier `SyntaxError` and no later stage (typecheck, test, build) runs; the failure is reported as a build failure while the message is really a parse error.

建议改动

Run the type checker before the formatter (or report a formatter parse error as a type/syntax failure) so the diagnostic and the stage name agree.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · 验收机制

Unit tests over pure helpers cannot catch filters that only fail when a repository compiles them

需人工判断

Two of this round's runtime defects (the empty enum value and the datetime bound on a date column) passed every existing test because the tests never invoked the domain method against a repository; the bad value only fails inside the query builder's validator. The defects were found by running the application, not by the gate.

建议改动

For a domain that builds repository queries, keep at least one test that drives the method against a recording repository (asserting the emitted filter), and treat a live application probe of every list/filter endpoint as part of the standard verification for a new feature.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · data-model

A route's `?? ''` default must be treated as absent by the domain

可自动化

Optional HTTP query parameters are handed to the domain as empty strings, so a domain that keys on `undefined` silently filters on an empty value for every absent parameter. The class of bug did not appear for parameters that happened to be truthy-checked.

建议改动

Normalise every optional string parameter with the shared `str` helper and branch on truthiness, and validate enum-valued parameters against their constant list before building the filter.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · data-model

A `date` column needs a date-only bound; a `datetime` column needs a full timestamp

可自动化

The same comparison helper accepts both, but the repository's temporal validator enforces the collection's declared type, so a datetime string against a `date` field fails at query time. Inclusive comparisons should use `notAfter`/`notBefore` rather than a strict bound plus an end-of-day time.

建议改动

When filtering a temporal field, check the declared column type (from the migration or the generated Collection artifacts) and build the bound at that precision; prefer the inclusive operators so a value exactly on the boundary is not dropped.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · data-model

Repair a drifted applied schema with a new conditional migration, never by replaying history

可自动化

When a migration file is edited after it has been applied, the recorded checksum no longer matches and the change is never replayed; `db redo` is unavailable when the applied batch also contains an irreversible migration, and `db reset` is destructive. Re-editing the file or the history table changes nothing.

建议改动

Add a new migration whose `up` performs only the missing delta and whose `shouldRun` checks the physical schema, so it is a no-op where the change already exists; prove it with `db apply` and leave the original file alone.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 07 · consistency

A capability flag and the domain rule it represents must be derived from one expression

可自动化

The page decides what to show from `capabilities().canUploadAttachment` while the endpoint enforces the rule in `registerAttachment`; when the two expressions were written separately they diverged and the page offered an action the domain refused.

建议改动

Compute the eligibility once (a named predicate shared by the capability builder and the enforcing method) so the button and the rule cannot drift.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 08 · 验收机制

A build failure makes the browser QA report a blank application rather than a build error, so the build log must be checked first

需人工判断

All twelve round-2 browser defects described one symptom (the template homepage and a Home-only menu). The root cause was a server typecheck error that stopped pnpm build, so the production dist that pnpm start serves was stale. Treating the browser report alone would send the next agent into the page and route code.

建议改动

When a browser run reports a globally empty application, check the build gate output before inspecting pages; only a successful build makes a browser observation about application behavior.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 09 · permissions

One page id covering many settings pages cannot express a partial grant

需人工判断

The AI plugin gates every AI settings action behind the single page `ai.settings`, which also carries manual upload and deletion. The requirement needs the supervisor to maintain the knowledge base while engineers must not upload or delete, and the only available choices were to grant the whole bundle or none of it.

建议改动

Let a settings provider declare its actions against finer-grained page ids (for example `ai.settings.knowledge`), so an application can grant maintenance without granting authoring.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 10 · runtime-config

The v3 runtime publishes its API base only in a served config block, so legacy consumers need a bridge

可自动化

`@nocobase/app-portal-sdk` reads `window.NOCOBASE_API_URL` at module load and otherwise assumes the server root, so under any non-root mount path its requests miss the base path. The v3 runtime intentionally leaves `window` untouched and exposes the base only in the `nocobase-runtime-config` JSON.

建议改动

Publish `NOCOBASE_API_URL` from the runtime bootstrap for plugins still on the legacy SDK, or make the SDK read the runtime-config block itself.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 11 · 验收机制

Template shell tests assert literal template copy, so a rebrand must update them without weakening the check

可自动化

`tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx` and `tests/logic/client-shell.test.tsx` asserted the template's own strings (`AI application workspace`, `Default Template v0.0.0`). Changing the application's copy failed them even though the behavior they test was intact.

建议改动

Have the shipped shell tests assert the keys resolve and change on language switch rather than the exact template words, so an application can rebrand without editing the tests.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 12 · frontend

A dialog that loads reference data must be mounted only for callers authorized to use it

需人工判断

An always-mounted dialog fetched customers and equipment for every visitor of the list page, producing 403s for read-only roles. React mounted the dialog regardless of the server-side authorization for its action.

建议改动

Gate the dialog (and its loader) on the same capability that gates the action, as the list page now does for managers.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 13 · i18n

A locale key that holds an object is not a translation string and must not be passed to `t()`

需人工判断

`service.workOrders.source` holds a nested object of per-source labels; a component passed it to `t()` as a React child and produced an object-child error. TypeScript cannot catch this where keys are string-typed.

建议改动

Reserve leaf keys for strings and give nested groups their own terminal key (as `sourceLabel` now does), and keep nested groups out of any component-visible `t()` call.

来源：Agent · retro.json

      "rootCause": "`sendOverdueReminders` only looked at inspection tasks and counted each attempt rather than each accepted delivery, so overdue work orders were never reminded; `schedulerRunner.run` triggered the registered target without consulting `plan.enabled`; and the two dialogs used a native <input type='date'> inside a form the dialog treated as dismissible on change.",

      "suggestedChange": "When filtering a temporal field, check the declared column type (from the migration or the generated Collection artifacts) and build the bound at that precision; prefer the inclusive operators so a value exactly on the boundary is not dropped.",

  3. 填写处理说明并 Confirm，工单进入待确认，时间线记录开始处理与提交结果
  4. 以主管（service.manager）登录打开同一工单，点击 Reject result，弹窗标题为 Reject result；空退回原因被拒，填写原因后 Confirm，状态回到处理中并记录退回原因
  5. 复现上轮同会话失败路径：在主管同一页面会话先 Submit resolution 并提交，再点 Reject result，弹窗仍为 Reject result（非 Submit resolution），确认后状态回到处理中且弹窗自动关闭
  6. 工程师再次打开工单重新提交处理说明，状态回到待确认
  7. 主管点击 Close work order，填写关闭备注并 Confirm，状态变为已关闭且弹窗自动关闭
  8. 检查已关闭工单只读性：无提交/退回/关闭/上传/分享控件；点击 Retry acceptance 状态仍为已关闭
  9. 刷新与跨会话重新打开工单，状态与处理结果保留

观察结果

  1. 开始处理成功：状态由 Awaiting processing 变为 In progress
  2. 空处理说明 Confirm 后弹窗保持打开、工单状态未变，说明被拒
  3. 填写说明提交后状态变为 Awaiting confirmation，Resolution 与 Timeline 正确记录
  4. 主管 Reject result 弹窗标题正确，空原因被拒；填写原因确认后状态回到 In progress，Resolution 显示 Last rejection 且时间线记录退回原因
  5. 上轮缺陷已修复：同一页面会话先提交处理说明后，Reject result 打开的仍是 Reject result 弹窗，确认返回成功（无 409），弹窗自动关闭
  6. 再次提交后主管关闭成功，状态 Closed，Timeline 记录“主管已关闭工单”，弹窗自动关闭
  7. 已关闭工单只读：无提交/退回/关闭/上传/分享按钮；Retry acceptance 点击后状态保持 Closed
  8. 重新加载及另一会话均显示 Closed，处理结果与退回记录保留

助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。 实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。

完整原始验收要求
每项只使用一组代表性正反场景，不展开全角色×全状态×全格式组合。浏览器 QA 验证页面行为；直接 API、并发/重复请求和服务端边界由实现阶段的针对性测试提供证据，不能用截图代替。

B01. 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

B02. 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。

B03. 负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。

B04. 甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。

B05. 有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。

B06. 上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。

B07. 受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。

B08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

B09. 主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。

B10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。

B11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

B12. 助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。
